design_rationale: Hard governance constraints determine the legal candidate set before latency ranking.
Policy-first remains the conservative legal fallback and need not be a performance winner under permissive raw-Join policy.
The performance admission requires at least two singleton winners among legal candidates.
Higher query selectivity and Join match rate probe the predicted query-first versus join-first crossover without using a learned threshold.
scientific_boundary: This is a development admission experiment, not a final optimizer evaluation.
The V1.1 negative result remains frozen and is not reclassified.
A V2 failure ends this candidate-boundary expansion rather than weakening gates.
No speedup or unseen-data generalization claim is authorized by V2.
